g.text: I am currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering at UNILASALLE, in Canoas,
developing a foundation in software engineering, programming, algorithms and software architecture.
Alongside my studies, I develop and maintain game modifications focused on performance, graphics,
compatibility and player experience. I also build Helyx, a personal desktop application developed
independently from the ground up, alongside tools and technical workflows for my projects.
Working across these projects has shaped the professional direction I want to pursue in the games
industry: Game Direction, Narrative Direction and Production.
My goal is to connect technical knowledge with storytelling, creative vision and production,
contributing to experiences from their underlying systems to the stories and player experiences
